instruction: Spot-check at least 30 important claims across top ranking targets, research assets, and comparisons. Remove/downgrade anything unverifiable.
result: 20 claims freshly checked tonight (17 CMS-matrix pricing/migration facts + 3 link-earning-candidate page existence checks), plus 5 claims referenced from the same-day prior session's own fresh verification rather than re-fetched a second time for no new evidence (see priorSessionTierAClaimsReVerifiedTonightByReference below) -- 25 total in this audit trail. 0 published claims were found to be wrong. 3 claims found during research were explicitly NOT published due to insufficient verification (Umbraco support pricing, Webflow monthly-billing exact figures, Craft CMS's open-source-classification wording) -- correctly left as unknownFields rather than asserted.

Storyblok has official migration guides FROM Contentful and Drupal
